class.name: CgameOwnershipLeases
class.brief_description: Expiring ownership leases with monotonic fencing tokens.
class.description: [CgameOwnershipLeases] grants time-bounded exclusive ownership of a key. The holder must stop acting before the lease expires, and the table does not re-grant until it has. Because a paused holder cannot notice its own expiry, every new grant carries a strictly increasing fencing token that the protected resource ([CgameFencedStore]) checks to reject stale writers. Time is passed in explicitly (seconds or ticks), so the table is deterministic.

method.name: acquire
method.description: Grants or re-confirms the lease and returns [code]{ok, token, expires}[/code]. A different holder is refused until the current lease has expired; a new grant always gets a higher token than any before it.

method.name: renew
method.description: Extends the lease. Refused once expired or when holder or token do not match the current grant.

method.name: release
method.description: Releases the lease. A stale holder or token is ignored.

method.name: holder_of
method.description: Returns the current holder, or an empty string when the key is free or expired.

method.name: token_of
method.description: Returns the last token ever issued for the key. It survives release and expiry.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns whether [param holder] holds the lease with exactly [param token] at [param now].

method.name: client_valid
method.description: Holder-side check with a clock drift allowance: returns [code]true[/code] only while [code]now < expires - drift[/code].

method.name: reap
method.description: Drops expired leases and returns their keys. Tokens are kept so the next grant is higher.

members.member: Active leases keyed by name: [code]holder[/code], [code]token[/code] and [code]expires[/code].
